clue.text: Reconstructing badly, not working to the highest standards

definitions.text: not working to the highest standards

indicators.note: something done badly is botched and disordered, so the letters of the first word are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: A shoddy rebuilding job by builders who do not meet proper standards.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes skimping on effort or quality to save time or money.

clue.text: Close agreement

definitions.meaning: close in the sense of tightly packed or dense
a formal pact or treaty between parties

explanation.definitionFit: Compact as an adjective means dense or closely packed; as a noun it is a pact or treaty.

clue.text: Bar of soap!

parts.note: not a cake of soap for washing but a pub in a television soap opera

explanation.walkthrough: The Rovers Return is the pub in Coronation Street, Britain's long-running TV soap opera set in a fictional Manchester district.
explanation.definitionFit: A cryptic reading: the bar (pub) that features in a famous British soap opera.

clue.text: Jot down the first nine letters

definitions.meaning: a jot is a tiny amount, a whit
counting down the Greek alphabet from alpha, the ninth letter is reached

explanation.walkthrough: Alpha, beta, gamma, delta, epsilon, zeta, eta, theta and then the ninth Greek letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Iota means a very small quantity, like a jot, and is also the ninth letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Going round the world is a smashing opportunity for a girl to tale in

indicators.note: to take in something is to admit or enclose it, so the girl surrounds the other piece

parts.note: gal is an informal word for a girl
in tennis a high lob invites the opponent to play a smash

explanation.surface: A young woman travelling worldwide sees a great chance to soak it all up.
explanation.definitionFit: Global means worldwide, extending across the whole earth.

clue.text: Its model form may be recalled

definitions.text: Its model form may be recalled

indicators.note: to form here is to shape or fashion, so the two words are reshaped into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A design or pattern that people might remember fondly.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: days gone by are what one recalls.
explanation.definitionFit: Days long past are the sort of thing remembered with nostalgia.

clue.text: Magic may concern transformations

indicators.note: transformations are changes of shape, so the letters of the two words are changed in order

explanation.surface: Magic might be all about turning one thing into another.
explanation.definitionFit: Necromancy is sorcery, especially communing with the dead.

clue.text: A sprite, goblin or wood elf maybe

indicators.note: maybe suggests the words could be a different arrangement, so their letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: An impish little creature, perhaps a goblin or a woodland elf.
explanation.walkthrough: Robin Goodfellow is the mischievous English folklore sprite also called Puck.
explanation.definitionFit: Robin Goodfellow is a hobgoblin of English folklore, a mischievous fairy.

clue.text: Replacing the last of the footlights

definitions.text: Replacing the last of the footlights

parts.words: Replacing the last of the footlights
parts.note: an old theatrical word for the row of lamps along the stage front, the forerunner of modern footlights

explanation.walkthrough: In theatre slang the footlights were once known by this name, from the early lamps that floated in troughs of oil.
explanation.definitionFit: Floats is a dated theatre term for footlights, the lamps along the front of the stage.

clue.text: Musician having ear most developed

indicators.note: developed means grown into a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A performer whose sense of hearing is the most advanced.
explanation.definitionFit: A maestro is a distinguished conductor or composer.

clue.text: A sound measure

parts.note: reads as a sensible step, but means a unit for gauging loudness

explanation.definitionFit: It is the unit used to express the intensity of noise.

clue.text: Cry from a small boat

parts.note: a hoy is a small coastal sailing vessel

explanation.surface: A shout from someone in a little craft.
explanation.definitionFit: The nautical hail used to attract attention from another vessel.

clue.text: State of Carolina if reformed

indicators.note: reformed means shaped again, so the letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A US state that might be a remodelled version of Carolina.
explanation.definitionFit: California is one of the fifty United States.

clue.text: Classification of chocolates?

parts.note: a sorting of sweets into kinds, or simply a mixed box of various sweets

explanation.definitionFit: An assortment is a sorting into groups, and also a mixed selection, as in a box of mixed sweets.

clue.text: Religion is embraced by them

indicators.note: something embraced by another is held inside it, so the small word sits within the larger

explanation.surface: Faith is something those people hold close.
explanation.definitionFit: Theism is belief in a god or gods, a religious stance.

clue.text: Treason's upsetting US politicians

indicators.note: upsetting means overturning and disordering, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the word with its s kept as a letter of the fodder

explanation.surface: Betraying the country is distressing American lawmakers.
explanation.definitionFit: Senators are members of the US Senate, the upper house of Congress.

clue.text: More of the same in Latin

definitions.text: More of the same in Latin

parts.words: More of the same in Latin
parts.note: the Latin phrase meaning and the rest, used to stand for further similar items

explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase means and other things, used for more items of the same kind.

clue.text: Gets into bad shape

parts.note: not becoming unfit but twisting something out of its proper form

explanation.definitionFit: To distort is to twist or deform something out of its true shape.

clue.text: Stop side replacing good man

indicators.note: replacing here means putting back in a different place, so the letters are reordered

parts.note: ST, short for saint, a crossword's usual good man

explanation.surface: A team being substituted for a decent player is halted.
explanation.definitionFit: To desist is to cease or refrain from an action.

clue.text: Sharp American intelligence organisation gets backing about detectives

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece goes round the other
backing means moving backwards, so the agency's initials are written in reverse

parts.note: CID, the Criminal Investigation Department of British police

explanation.surface: A tart US spy agency is supported in a matter involving police investigators.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gets backing' turns CIA into AIC, which then goes 'about' CID.
explanation.definitionFit: Acidic means tart or sour in taste, hence sharp.

clue.text: Bob may be crusty about a point

indicators.note: about can mean in a different arrangement, so the letters are moved around

parts.note: E is east, a point of the compass

explanation.surface: Someone with a short haircut may be gruff about something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bob' looks like a haircut or a name; here it is a quick bending of the knee.
explanation.definitionFit: A bob is a brief bow or bending of the knees, a respectful gesture.

clue.text: Intentionally aggravating?

parts.note: annoying, or making a deliberate attempt

explanation.definitionFit: Trying means annoying, and also attempting, which is done on purpose.

clue.text: The tears we shed for a loved one

indicators.note: shed tears are scattered, so the letters fall into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone crying over a beloved partner.
explanation.definitionFit: A sweetheart is a beloved partner or darling.

clue.text: Expensive address

definitions.meaning: a form of address, as in opening a letter to someone

explanation.definitionFit: Dear means costly, and is the word used to address someone at the start of a letter.

clue.text: Can it turn the tide for the overweight?

definitions.text: Can it turn the tide for the overweight?

indicators.note: to turn the word is to rearrange its letters

explanation.surface: Wondering whether something can reverse the fortunes of heavy people.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines too: a slimming regime may change things for the overweight.
explanation.definitionFit: A restricted eating plan is the usual remedy for being too heavy.

clue.text: Show of affection for which one gets no credit

definitions.text: for which one gets no credit
definitions.meaning: a credit restriction, when lending is cut back

explanation.definitionFit: A squeeze is a hug, and a credit squeeze is a tightening of lending.

clue.text: They are suspended in cold weather

definitions.text: They are suspended in cold weather

parts.words: They are suspended in cold weather
parts.note: not people barred from work in winter but frozen spikes hanging from eaves

explanation.definitionFit: Icicles are hanging spikes of ice formed by dripping water freezing.

clue.text: The big fish, by all accounts

definitions.text: The big fish, by all accounts

parts.words: The big fish, by all accounts
parts.note: the angler's tale of the huge catch that escaped, which grows with each telling

explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for the huge catch an angler boasts of losing, unverifiable and hence 'by all accounts'.
